sentences.en: Nowadays, few ordinary city dwellers ever use the word "wattle".
sentences.zh: 如今，很少有普通城市居民会用到“wattle”这个词。

sentences.en: City dwellers have a higher death rate than country people do.
sentences.zh: 城市居民的死亡率比乡村居民高。

sentences.en: Who are you, dweller of this tiny stellar corpse?
sentences.zh: 你是这个小小恒星遗骸的哪一位居住者？

phrases.zh: 城市居民：在城市里生活的人
